crosswalks.historical_boundary: Gyeongsang province as the union of Gyeongju-do, Andong-do, Sangju-do and Jinju-do in the 1432 Gyeongsangdojiriji
crosswalks.resolution_method: The source's four subdivision centers and county map (Kim 2022, pp. 231-237, Tables 2-4 and Figure 1) are aligned to the four homonymous EU5 province groups; dongnae_province is included to cover the southeast coastal counties assigned to Gyeongju-do in the register. Together they form a contiguous southeast-Korea polygon and exclude Jeolla, Chungcheong, Gangwon and the capital region.
crosswalks.notes: The conservative 0.96 coverage reflects the coarse EU5 coastline and county generalization. Because this is a one-sided registered-population lower bound, any small selector overcoverage cannot make the inequality too demanding: the larger containing land area must still support at least the recorded provincial population.
